config_name: MacBook Air 13-inch — M5 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: Same 53.8Wh cell across the Air 13 line.

price.notes: Verified from apple.com/ca buy page (fullPrice 2549.00). BestBuy.ca carries Air 13 M5 configs with periodic sales.

reviews.quote: In almost every benchmark, the M5 Air beats similarly priced Windows laptops... almost impossible to beat the price-performance ratio.
It can easily last through a full workday without needing to recharge.
For many, it's the best Mac around.

praises: The do-everything Air: 24GB + 1TB removes both classic pain points for years of ownership
Fastest single-core performance you can buy in a silent 1.23 kg laptop (NBC)
Full workday-plus battery with the 10-core GPU (RTINGS)
Resale value stays high — M-series Airs hold price on the used market (r/apple consensus)
Silent, cool chassis; works fine on a lap for hours (Amazon.ca reviews)
complaints: At C$2,549 you're within C$250 of a MacBook Pro 14 M6 — hard sell (top r/macbook debate)
Soldered RAM/SSD: this premium config locks in your choices permanently
60Hz notched panel is the weakest part of an otherwise complete package
Fanless throttling on long renders/compiles is why pros buy the Pro instead
Only 2 ports; no HDMI or SD card for creators who got talked out of the Pro

design_philosophy: The maxed mainstream Air — everything configurable in the 13-inch chassis except a fan and a 120Hz screen. Apple positions it for buyers who want longevity (24GB/1TB) without paying for Pro features they won't use.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from directly-tested M5 13-inch base (NBC 92%, RTINGS 8.3): GPU and RAM bumps as in parts 02/03. Image is Apple specs-page CDN jpg. Sentiment from pro reviews + Amazon.ca aggregate; Reddit API blocked (403).
